mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the last 3 months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% in the previous 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last month signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 1% over the last 3 months, it signals a strong demand environment, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and GDPC1 increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 increased by more than their respective thresholds in the previous 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% over the last month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS was above 2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the last 6 months signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and reducing corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% over the previous 6 months.
